2607.05069.title: MIRAGE: Defending Long-Form RAG Against Misinformation Pollution
2607.05069.paper_summary: Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) improves factuality by grounding LLMs in external evidence, but real-world retrieval is often polluted: semantically relevant passages may contain subtle misinformation, misleading framings, or fabrications. We introduce MIRAGE, a training-free, model-agnostic defense for long-form RAG. MIRAGE builds an NLI-based cross-document claim graph and applies a Defended-Claims Gate to either condition generation on a consistent, multi-source supported subset or to block retrieval and answer parametrically. We also release a minimal-edit pollution protocol spanning four perturbation families (Unambiguous, Conflicting, Misleading, Fabricated) to construct matched clean, mixed, and fully polluted evaluation regimes. Across four long-form QA benchmarks and multiple commercial and open-weight LLMs, pollution severely degrades vanilla RAG, while MIRAGE consistently restores factuality under mixed and fully polluted evidence and outperforms prior robust-RAG methods. Our implementation and datasets are available at https://github.com/SaadElDine/MIRAGE.
2607.05069.paper_summary_zh: 檢索增強生成（RAG）透過將大型語言模型（LLMs）與外部證據結合來提高事實性，但現實世界的檢索往往受到污染：語義相關的段落可能包含微妙的錯誤信息、誤導性的框架或虛構內容。我們介紹了MIRAGE，一種無需訓練、模型無關的長格式RAG防禦方法。MIRAGE建立了一個基於自然語言推理（NLI）的跨文檔主張圖，並應用了一個防禦主張閘，以便在一致的、多來源支持的子集上進行生成，或以參數方式阻止檢索和回答。我們還發布了一個最小編輯污染協議，涵蓋四種擾動類別（明確、衝突、誤導、虛構），以構建匹配的乾淨、混合和完全污染的評估體系。在四個長格式問答基準和多個商業及開放權重的LLMs中，污染嚴重降低了原始RAG的性能，而MIRAGE在混合和完全污染的證據下持續恢復事實性，並超越了先前的穩健RAG方法。我們的實現和數據集可在 https://github.com/SaadElDine/MIRAGE 獲得。
